<!-- AI Mock Interview code -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // Call the function immediately when the DOM is ready
    fetchUserData();
});

async function fetchUserData() {
    const API_URL = 'https://qa-ai-mock-interview.interviewkickstart.com/api/v1/ai_mock_interview/user-info';

    try {
        const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
            method: 'GET',
            // This allows the browser to send domain cookies (HttpOnly)
            credentials: 'include', 
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'Accept': 'application/json'
            }
        });

        if (response.status === 401) {
            console.warn('User is not authenticated or cookie expired.');
            return;
        }

        const data = await response.json();
        console.log('User Data:', data);
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Fetch error:', error);
    }
}
const roundSelect = document.getElementById('mi-round');
  const topicSelect = document.getElementById('mi-topic');
  const miForm = document.getElementById('mi-form');

  // --- API Fetching Logic ---
  roundSelect.addEventListener('change', async function() {
    const selectedRound = this.value;
    
    // Reset and show loading state
    topicSelect.disabled = true;
    topicSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="" disabled selected>Loading topics...</option>';

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`https://qa-ai-mock-interview.interviewkickstart.com/api/v1/ai_mock_interview/topics?round=${selectedRound}`);
      const data = await response.json();

      // Clear existing options
      topicSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="" disabled selected>Select a topic</option>';

      // Populate new options from API
      // Assuming API returns { "topics": ["Topic 1", "Topic 2"] }
      if (data.topics && data.topics.length > 0) {
        data.topics.forEach(topic => {
          const option = document.createElement('option');
          option.value = topic;
          option.textContent = topic;
          topicSelect.appendChild(option);
        });
        topicSelect.disabled = false;
      } else {
        topicSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="" disabled selected>No topics found</option>';
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching topics:", error);
      topicSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="" disabled selected>Error loading topics</option>';
    }
  });

  // --- Form Submission Logic ---
  miForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const round = roundSelect.value;
    const topic = topicSelect.value;
    const name = document.getElementById('mi-name').value;
    const difficulty = document.querySelector('input[name="difficulty"]:checked').value;

    if (!round || !topic || !name) {
      alert("Please complete all fields.");
      return;
    }

    const baseUrl = 'https://qa-mi.interviewkickstart.com/configurations';
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      round: round.toUpperCase(), // Adjust case if needed
      difficulty: difficulty.toUpperCase(),
      topic: topic,
      name: name
    });

    window.location.href = `${baseUrl}?${params.toString()}`;
  });

// glow functionality
// Select all elements with the ID (using the attribute selector for safety)
const startButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[id="start-mock-int-btn"]');
const targetForm = document.querySelector('.start-interview-form');

startButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        
        // 1. Smooth scroll to the form
        targetForm.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        
        // 2. Reset the animation if it was already played
        targetForm.classList.remove('active-glow');
        
        // Force a reflow (browser "reset" for the animation)
        void targetForm.offsetWidth; 
        
        // 3. Start the 2-cycle glow
        targetForm.classList.add('active-glow');
    });
});
</script>
